EBVPD – Europos bendrasis viešųjų pirkimų dokumentas, aktuali deklaracija, pakeičianti kompetentingų institucijų išduodamus dokumentus ir preliminariai patvirtinanti, kad tiekėjas ir ūkio subjektai, kurių pajėgumais jis remiasi pagal VPĮ 49 straipsnį (VPĮ 88 straipsnio 5 dalies nuostatų taikymo atvejais ir subtiekėjai), atitinka pirkimo dokumentuose pagal VPĮ 46, 47, 48 straipsnius nustatytus reikalavimus ir, jeigu taikytina, 54 straipsnyje nustatytus reikalavimus dėl kokybės vadybos sistemos ir (arba) aplinkos apsaugos vadybos sistemos standartų laikymosi, kurio forma prieinama interneto svetainėje http://ebvpd.eviesiejipirkimai.lt/espd-web/. Įgaliotoji organizacija – pirkimams organizuoti, pirkimo procedūroms iki sutarties ar preliminariosios sutarties sudarymo atlikti, taip pat atlikto pirkimo procedūrų ataskaitai ar skelbimui apie sudarytą sutartį ar preliminariąją sutartį pateikti perkančiosios organizacijos įgaliota organizacija, nurodyta specialiosiose pirkimo sąlygose. Komisija – viešojo pirkimo komisija. Perkančioji organizacija – specialiosiose pirkimo sąlygose nurodyta perkančioji organizacija. Pirkimas – perkančiosios organizacijos atliekamas viešasis pirkimas. Preliminarioji sutartis – preliminarioji viešojo pirkimo-pardavimo sutartis (jei taikoma), vienos ar k

PĮ 49 straipsnį (jeigu perkančioji organizacija nustato tiekėjo kvalifikacijos reikalavimus); pasiūlymo teikimo metu žinomi subtiekėjai (jeigu perkančioji organizacija nustato reikalavimus dėl subtiekėjų pašalinimo pagrindų). fiziniai asmenys, kuriuos tiekėjas ketina įdarbinti Pirkimo laimėjimo atveju ir kurių pajėgumais tiekėjas remiasi pagal VPĮ 49 (kvazisubtiekėjai) (jeigu perkančioji organizacija nustato reikalavimus dėl fizinių asmenų, kurių kvalifikacija tiekėjas remiasi ir kuriuos, pirkimo laimėjimo atveju, tiekėjas ketina įdarbinti, pašalinimo pagrindų). EBVPD pildomas jį įkėlus interneto svetainėje http://ebvpd.eviesiejipirkimai.lt/espd-web/. Tiekėjas, pildydamas EBVPD, laukelyje „Procedūros tipas“ turi pasirinkti „Atvira“. Teikdamas pasiūlymą CVP IS priemonėmis šį EBVPD tiekėjas turi pridėti kartu su kitais pasiūlymo dokumentais (pasiūlymo pateikimo skiltyje „Prisegti dokumentus“). EBVPD nurodytą informaciją pagrindžiantys dokumentai kartu su pasiūlymu neteikiami. Perkančioji organizacija bet kuriuo pirkimo procedūros metu gali paprašyti dalyvių pateikti visus ar dalį dokumentų, patvirtinančių jų pašalinimo pagrindų nebuvimą, atitiktį kvalifikacijos reikalavimams ir, jeigu taikytina, kokybės vadybos sistemos ir (arba) aplinkos apsaugos vadybos sistemos standartams, jeig

Section III: System, Technical, & Security Requirements To safeguard the Air Force enterprise and comply with Department of Defense directives, all proposed solutions must meet strict technical and security mandates. Requirement Description Compliance Type Architecture Compatibility Server-side must be compatible with on-premises and government-managed Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Eligibility Requirement Licensing Model Proposed licensing must be based on server instances and/or limited client-side authoring seats. Section I: Program Overview & Background 1.1 Purpose The Department of the Air Force (DAF), Business and Enterprise Systems (BES) Directorate, AFLCMC/GBGD, is issuing this Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO) to identify and acquire an innovative, commercially available Digital Adoption Platform (DAP). This platform will replace the legacy Oracle User Productivity Kit (UPK), which is reaching its official end-of-life. The primary goal of this acquisition is to secure a modern, sustainable, enterprise-ready so

User Productivity Kit (UPK), which is reaching its official end-of-life. The primary goal of this acquisition is to secure a modern, sustainable, enterprise-ready software-guided training and performance-support tool. It must streamline content creation, simplify software adoption, and provide real-time in-application guidance for the DEAMS user base. 1.2 Mission Impact & Capability Gap The current solution (Oracle UPK) represents unsupported software and significant technical debt. Its retirement creates a critical operational gap in how training is conducted across the enterprise. The replacement DAP will modernize training material outputs, provide interactive in-application assistance, and reduce the overall training footprint. This capability is designated as a Criticality (1) — Must Have requirement to support continuous financial and enterprise operations. 1.3 Scope of the Target Environment • User Base: Approximately 26,000+ geographically dispersed personnel across 170+ global locations. • Primary Integration: Stable and proven integration with Oracle e-Business Suite (EBS) (including F orms & OAF pages) and modern web applications. • Target Environments: The DAP must be deployable and tested across both Development (Dev) and Test environments before transitioning to

The current legacy analog infrastructure limits scalability, resilience, and interoperability. Under this Call for Solutions, the selected vendor will deliver, integrate, install, and acceptance-test a flexible, open-standard, modular Digital IF solution across up to twenty (20) worldwide satellite communications (SATCOM) teleport sites. Increment 1 will establish a fully operational baseline designed to support subsequent capability upgrades and integrations in future fiscal years. SECTION 2 – REQUIREMENT DESCRIPTION PROBLEM STATEMENT Area of Interest: Modular Digital Intermediate Frequency Solu

quires an open-standard Digital IF architecture. However, before committing to a full-scale global deployment, the DoW must validate the operation, interoperability, security, and performance of these modular commercial solutions in a rigorous representative environment. Technical Objective & Scope The DoW seeks a commercial solution for an Increment 1 Digital IF capability set built on a flexible, open standard (e.g., Digital Intermediate Frequency Interoperability compliant), modular architecture. The selected solution will undergo standard site acceptance testing and operational verification to confirm compliance with contract performance requirements and site compatibility. Upon successful acceptance, this operational configuration will serve as the standardized baseline for deployment and installation across up to twenty (20) worldwide SATCOM teleport sites. Mission Impact Successful validation and deployment of this flexible open-standard Digital IF architecture will directly enhance warfighter lethality and survivability by delivering a highly resilient, agile, and survivable GEO-SATCOM capability which rapidly adapts to contested/congested environments. The Government of the People’s Republic of Bangladesh has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of Technical Assistance Facility under the Learning Acceleration in Secondary Education (LAISE) Program and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services.

The consulting services (“the Services”) include undertaking a comprehensive assessment of ICT infrastructure and institutional readiness, the status and readiness of Multimedia Classrooms (MMCs), and teachers’ competencies and readiness to deliver ICT-enabled teaching using ICT facilities and MMCs.

The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment can be found at the following website: www.dshe.gov.bd or can be obtained at the address given below. The duration of the assignment will be about 06 (Six) months. The assignment is expected to commence in March 2027.

The Directorate of Secondary and Higher Education now invites eligible firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. The purpose of this system is to detect anomalies in real-time through comparison of historical process conditions and real-time information; and also provide the means for users to access this data; to display high-quality graphics; plot and trend this data; and provide notification of equipment performance anomalies. The anomaly detection system must be designed to accommodate very large real-time and historical databases so that multiple anomaly detection models can be run simultaneously. The models must be scalable and efficient so that they can run at any interval up to once every 1 minute, as required by the end user. The results of all calculations must be stored on-line for years, in its original resolution preferably within Reclamation’s historian. The archive results must not in any way affect the calculated data from its original resolution and sampled state. With this high-resolution data available, users can view both the plant conditions and analytic results while providing a very clear and accurate picture of past operations. The system must also provide a method for managing and dispositioning alarms. Any dispositioned alarm should be easily accessible; users should be able to bring up a full analytic copy of all alarm information associated with a dispositioned alarm. Specified Federal procurement payment means any payment made pursuant to a contract with a foreign contracting party that is for goods, manufactured or produced, or services provided in a foreign country that is not a party to an international procurement agreement with the United States. For purposes of the prior sentence, a foreign country does not include an outlying area. United States person as defined in 26 U.S.C. 7701(a)(30) means— (1) A citizen or resident of the United States; (2) A domestic partnership; (3) A domestic corporation; (4) Any estate (other than a foreign estate, within the meaning of 26 U.S.C. 701(a)(31)); and (5) Any trust if— (i) A court within the United States is able to exercise primary supervision over the administration of the trust; and (ii) One or more United States persons have the authority to control all substantial decisions of the trust.
